notes:
Lead profile:
- Startup: B2B SaaS (team marketplace for freelance consultants). Building an in-app assistant to help customers find relevant consultants and summarize conversation threads.
- Primary ask: low-latency streaming chat integrated into web + iOS SDK. P95 latency target quoted repeatedly: 'can't be >200ms; ideal ~100ms for typing/response feel'.
- Concurrency: initial cohort 500 DAU with bursts up to 2-3k concurrent chat sessions during business hours; budget-conscious — wants cost estimate for 10k monthly active users.
- Model preference: open models or small-parameter variants; willing to test Redwood-verified low-latency builds. Interested in streaming endpoints and token-level cost breakdown.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 required for marketplace partners; SSO (SAML) for internal admin; audit logs and retention policy needed (30–90 days). No on-prem or VPC at this stage — wants hosted public cloud.
- Quote from CTO Alex: 'We need the chat to feel instant. If generation stalls, UX drops off. Also want a small integration footprint for our React Native app.'
- Integration notes: experimenting with SDK + websockets prototype; asked whether Redwood supports continuous partial outputs + event hooks for typing indicator. Marcus to demo streaming sample.
- Salesplay: push self-serve quickstart + perf numbers, propose 30-day pilot using hosted_api free credits, follow w/ short technical session.
- Risks: if p95 not met they will try managed latency trickery client-side or look at competitors with specialized low-latency offerings. Budget approval needed from CEO for paid tier.
- Recommended action: share 1-page streaming performance cheat-sheet, include example configs for batching, kv-cache, and small-quant models; offer to connect with someone from Optimize team for cost tuning.
